_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Here's what I changed to use `jclinic.jpg` as the site logo:

### 1. Move the image to `public/`
Next.js serves static files from `public/`, so I moved your file to:

`public/jclinic.jpg`

It’s now available at `/jclinic.jpg` in the browser.

### 2. Update the header
The header had a CSS gradient placeholder (`.mark`). It now uses your image via Next.js `Image`:

```10:28:components/ui/Header.tsx
export function Header({
  brand,
  tagline,
  actions,
  logoSrc = "/jclinic.jpg",
}: HeaderProps) {
  return (
    <header className={styles.header} data-tour="brand">
      <div className={styles.brandBlock}>
        <Image
          src={logoSrc}
          alt=""
          width={34}
          height={34}
          className={styles.logo}
          priority
        />
```

### 3. Set the browser tab icon
In `app/layout.tsx`, I added metadata so the same image shows as the favicon:

```tsx
icons: {
  icon: "/jclinic.jpg",
  apple: "/jclinic.jpg",
},
```

After a refresh, you should see the logo in the top-left header and in the browser tab. If you also want to change the text from "Forest Lab" to something like "J Clinic", say the word and I can update that too.
